thesis: A government-IT incumbent with ROIC well above its FY2021-23 levels and an 11.0% FCF margin trades below its own 5-year minimum on every earnings multiple and below peers, where the price implies a revenue decline that raised EPS guidance does not show.
reason: Nothing material has changed since the HOLD at conviction 4 on 2026-11-16: cash generation holds, the ROIC dip is acquisition capital, and multiples sit below their own 5-year lows. Modest value-blend upside and no trend support keep it in the hold band, not an ADD; the position keeps its size.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below 10.5%, reversing most of the five-year expansion from 8.5% to 11.8%.
TTM ROIC falls below 13%, showing the decline from 16.6% is no longer an acquisition denominator effect.
TTM FCF margin falls below 8%, back to the level of a year earlier.
Net debt/EBITDA on the ratios page rises above 3.0x (2.46x TTM now) without a visible deleveraging path from the Entrust debt.
